benchmarks.name: alphaXiv ArXivQA Retrieval
benchmarks.notes: Firecrawl reports 53.3% recall at $0.32/task versus 45.4% for the next best system, plus MRR 0.750, on roughly 200 alphaXiv ArXivQA queries. Vendor-reported and registered as citation-only metadata for literature-search; non-scoring until datasetHash, benchmarkInputHash, runAt, attestor, a reproducible harness, and verifier/CI provenance exist.
